name: Rope, straps and webbing
summary: Rope, cord, ratchet straps, webbing and bungees for lashing, hauling and building.
uses: Webbing for slings, carry straps and repairs
identify: Hardware, marine and outdoor stores, truck depots, removal firms and sailing boats. Overlooked sources: car seat belts (very strong webbing), flagpole halyards, window blind cords and trampoline nets.
test: Check the full length for cuts, melted or glazed spots, mould and fading: sun-faded synthetic rope has lost much of its strength. Never trust salvaged rope to hold a person.

decay.note: Stored rope lasts; nylon and polypropylene left in sunlight weaken within a year or two.
